name: NodePing

evidence.uptime: U01, U02: HTTP, TCP, DNS, SMTP and database checks every 15 to 60 s (U03)
evidence.status: S01, S03: status pages built from monitor state, with custom domains on paid plans
evidence.cron: J01, J02: PUSH heartbeats that fail when a report is missing (J01)

line: Checks websites and services, then shows their status and uptime history.

cells.interval: 15 s Premiere; 30 s Professional; 60 s base

uptime.math: 5 HTTP endpoints checked every 60 seconds. $10 a month includes 5 monitors and a custom-domain report, but not managed SSL for the report.
$10 a month, plus 20 extra monitors beyond the included ones at $0.50 each, comes to $20 for 25 active monitors. Each endpoint uses one primary probe.
$25 a month includes up to 200 active monitors. 100 endpoints at 60 seconds, with managed SSL for the report.
